names.legendary: The Cactus That Bloomed Once a Century

lore.common: Prods everyone who reaches past it for the window latch.
lore.uncommon: Is forgotten for months without water and still looks smug.
lore.rare: Stores so much water in its stem that it grows a new arm just to show off.
lore.epic: Spread across the whole windowsill with its babies until the curtains couldn't close.
lore.legendary: Bloomed one perfect pink flower after a hundred years, and the whole street came to look.

names.legendary: The Box That Sorted the Street

lore.common: Gets the wrong things put in it every single week.
lore.uncommon: Rattles with glass bottles all the way to the kerb.
lore.rare: Refuses to be collected if one yoghurt pot is unwashed.
lore.epic: Clattered so loudly on bin night that the whole street woke up at once.
lore.legendary: Sorted the whole street's rubbish so perfectly that the bin lorry crew sent it a thank-you card.

names.legendary: The Crate That Carried the Whole Party

lore.common: Overflows the morning after every party.
lore.uncommon: Stacks bottles so high that they clink in the wind.
lore.rare: Sits on the kerb so long that the crisp packets inside start a new life.
lore.epic: Toppled off the kerb and sent a hundred bottles rolling down the hill.
lore.legendary: Carried every bottle from the street party to the recycling centre in one trip.

names.legendary: The Flower That Bloomed in Winter

lore.common: Makes everyone with hay fever sneeze three times in a row.
lore.uncommon: Has a bee on it every single time you lean in to smell it.
lore.rare: Turns its head to follow the sun all day long.
lore.epic: Bloomed with a thousand friends on the same morning, and the meadow turned completely pink.
lore.legendary: Bloomed in the middle of winter through the snow, and the whole village came to see it.

names.legendary: The Tent That Survived the Summit

lore.common: Always has one pole missing when you get to the campsite.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its flysheet all night so loudly that nobody sleeps.
lore.rare: Bends in the wind so far that it almost touches the ground, then springs back.
lore.epic: Collapsed on the whole camping group in the middle of the night, and everyone woke up wearing it.
lore.legendary: Stood firm on a mountain top through a storm that blew every other tent away.

names.legendary: The Wheel That Churned the River

lore.common: Splashes everyone standing too close to the side of the boat.
lore.uncommon: Churns the river into white foam behind it.
lore.rare: Turns so fast that the boat overtakes the ducks.
lore.epic: Splashed every passenger on the river cruise, and the whole boat came back soaked.
lore.legendary: Has turned on the same river steamer for a hundred years and still carries passengers every summer.

names.legendary: Granny Flourworth of the Kitchen

lore.common: Gets flour in its pocket that puffs out every time you reach in.
lore.uncommon: Has strings that tie themselves into a knot behind your back.
lore.rare: Catches every splash of gravy, so its owner always looks spotless.
lore.epic: Was worn by every baker at the bake sale, and the hall was covered in icing sugar.
lore.legendary: Has been worn for every family feast for forty years and still has the first cake stain.

names.legendary: The Pinafore That Picked Strawberries

lore.common: Has a big bow at the back that keeps coming undone.
lore.uncommon: Is worn over everything and covered in little flowers.
lore.rare: Has pockets so deep that it carries a whole picnic.
lore.epic: Was worn by every helper at the garden party, and the lawn looked like a field of flowers.
lore.legendary: Picked every strawberry on the farm in one morning, all into its deep front pocket.

names.legendary: The Jacket That Floated a Whole Crew

lore.common: Is so bulky that its wearer can't put their arms down.
lore.uncommon: Has a little whistle attached that everyone blows on the first day.
lore.rare: Bobs its wearer so high in the water that they look like a cork.
lore.epic: Was worn by every child at the lake camp, and the water looked full of bobbing oranges.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole sailing crew floating until the lifeboat arrived, and everyone came home safe.

names.legendary: The Feeder Every Bird Knew

lore.common: Is raided by the squirrel within an hour of being filled.
lore.uncommon: Spills seeds all over the lawn, which grow into weeds.
lore.rare: Attracts so many birds that the garden sounds like a choir.
lore.epic: Brought every bird in the town to one garden on the coldest morning of winter.
lore.legendary: Fed a robin that came back every day for ten years to sit on the kitchen windowsill.

names.legendary: The House That Raised a Hundred Chicks

lore.common: Sits empty all spring while the birds nest in the hedge instead.
lore.uncommon: Has a little round hole that only the right-sized bird can fit through.
lore.rare: Chirps from inside so loudly that the cat sits underneath and stares.
lore.epic: Was moved into by a family of blue tits, and the whole garden came to watch them grow.
lore.legendary: Has raised a hundred chicks over twenty springs, and every one fledged safely.

names.legendary: The Flap That Ate the Post

lore.common: Snaps shut on the postman's fingers every single morning.
lore.uncommon: Lets in a cold draught all winter long.
lore.rare: Swallows the post and spits it onto the mat face down.
lore.epic: Snapped shut on a whole stack of birthday cards, and they scattered across the hall.
lore.legendary: Has let a million letters through the same front door for a hundred years.

names.legendary: The Mushroom Ring of the Old Wood

lore.common: Pops up overnight in the middle of the lawn, where it wasn't yesterday.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a perfect circle that people call a fairy ring.
lore.rare: Changes colour when touched, so everyone learns to look and not pick.
lore.epic: Sprouted all over the football pitch after the rain, and the match was moved to the car park.
lore.legendary: Has grown in the same ring in the same wood for three hundred years, getting a little wider each autumn.

names.legendary: The Saucer That Saved the Carpet

lore.common: Overflows every time the plant is watered.
lore.uncommon: Hides a puddle under the pot that nobody notices for weeks.
lore.rare: Becomes a hotel for every slug in the garden.
lore.epic: Overflowed under every plant on the windowsill, and the carpet got a big wet stripe.
lore.legendary: Saved a precious carpet from a hundred waterings without a single drip.

names.legendary: The Planter That Fed a Family

lore.common: Grows more weeds than flowers.
lore.uncommon: Is so heavy when full of soil that nobody can move it.
lore.rare: Grows every herb the kitchen needs all summer.
lore.epic: Grew so many tomatoes that the family gave them to every neighbour on the street.
lore.legendary: Grew enough vegetables in one summer to feed a whole family every evening.

names.legendary: The Rose That Climbed the Tower

lore.common: Pricks your finger with a thorn every time you try to smell it.
lore.uncommon: Drops its petals all over the table the day after you pick it.
lore.rare: Smells so strong that bees come from three gardens away.
lore.epic: Bloomed all over the garden wall at once, and the whole street smelled of roses.
lore.legendary: Climbed all the way up the old tower and bloomed at the very top.

names.legendary: The Sled That Broke the Record

lore.common: Clatters down the ice track so loudly that the spectators cover their ears.
lore.uncommon: Takes the bends so tightly that its crew nearly touch the walls.
lore.rare: Goes so fast that the spectators only hear a whoosh.
lore.epic: Raced down the ice track in record time, and the crowd's hats blew off.
lore.legendary: Won the championship by a hundredth of a second and was kept in the museum.

names.legendary: The Sled That Crossed the Snow

lore.common: Gets pulled by dogs who bark the whole way.
lore.uncommon: Sprays snow up behind it like a little white storm.
lore.rare: Finds trails through snow that no map shows.
lore.epic: Raced across the frozen lake with twenty dogs pulling, and the whole village cheered.
lore.legendary: Crossed a whole snowy wilderness to deliver medicine to a far-away village.

names.legendary: The Board That Rode Itself Home

lore.common: Zooms off before its rider has finished standing on it.
lore.uncommon: Runs out of battery just at the bottom of the biggest hill.
lore.rare: Rolls so silently that pigeons don't notice it until too late.
lore.epic: Zoomed through the whole park so fast that the joggers felt like they were standing still.
lore.legendary: Rode itself home after its owner fell off, and waited at the front door.

names.legendary: The Board That Spun Round the House

lore.common: Wobbles under its rider until they wave their arms like a windmill.
lore.uncommon: Spins round in circles when its rider leans the wrong way.
lore.rare: Carries its rider sideways into the kitchen when they only meant to go forwards.
lore.epic: Spun round the whole living room and knocked over every lamp.
lore.legendary: Was ridden round every room in the house without touching a single wall.

names.legendary: The Jet Ski That Raced the Dolphins

lore.common: Jumps every wave so hard that its rider lands with a bump.
lore.uncommon: Sprays water over everyone on the beach.
lore.rare: Starts with such a roar that every swimmer turns round.
lore.epic: Jumped every wave in the bay in one afternoon, and the beach was soaked.
lore.legendary: Raced a pod of dolphins across the bay and came second, very happily.

names.legendary: The Ski That Won the Slalom

lore.common: Crosses over the other ski and sends its skier face first into the snow.
lore.uncommon: Falls off the ski lift and has to be fetched from the bottom.
lore.rare: Ploughs through snow so deep that it leaves a trench.
lore.epic: Tumbled down the slope with every beginner in the ski school, and they all landed in one pile.
lore.legendary: Won the slalom race by a whisker after crossing the finish line backwards.

names.legendary: The Sled That Flew Over the Bump

lore.common: Bumps into every tree on the way down the hill.
lore.uncommon: Is pulled up the hill by its rope, which always feels heavier than going down.
lore.rare: Races down the hill so fast that its rider screams with joy.
lore.epic: Raced down the hill with every sled in the village on the first snowy day.
lore.legendary: Flew over the big bump at the bottom of the hill and landed in a snowdrift with a cheer.

names.legendary: The Board That Did a Triple Spin

lore.common: Takes ten minutes to strap into, then falls over straight away.
lore.uncommon: Spends more time on its rider's bottom than on the snow.
lore.rare: Flies up the half-pipe so high that its rider waves to the ski lift.
lore.epic: Did a trick in the half-pipe that every snowboarder on the mountain tried to copy.
lore.legendary: Spun three times in the air and landed perfectly in the final.

names.legendary: The Board That Rode the Giant Wave

lore.common: Wipes out its rider on every second wave.
lore.uncommon: Is covered in wax that sticks to everyone's feet.
lore.rare: Catches waves that nobody else can even see coming.
lore.epic: Caught the biggest wave of the day with every surfer on the beach watching.
lore.legendary: Rode the biggest wave of the year all the way to the beach, and the whole town cheered.

names.legendary: The Mattress That Floated to the Island

lore.common: Slowly leaks overnight so you wake up on the floor.
lore.uncommon: Takes an hour of pumping before it's even half full.
lore.rare: Floats on the lake so gently that its rider falls asleep.
lore.epic: Leaked under every camper on the same night, and the whole tent woke up on the ground.
lore.legendary: Floated a sleeping holidaymaker all the way across the bay to a tiny island.

names.legendary: The Mat That Found Every Stone

lore.common: Fights back every time you try to roll it up.
lore.uncommon: Is so thin that you feel every pebble under your back.
lore.rare: Finds the one stone under the tent and puts it right under your hip.
lore.epic: Was rolled out by every camper at the scout camp, and the hall floor disappeared.
lore.legendary: Has camped on every mountain in the country and still rolls up tightly.

names.legendary: The Mat Under the Stars

lore.common: Slips across the tent floor all night so you end up by the door.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles every time you turn over.
lore.rare: Catches the morning dew so the sleeping bag stays dry.
lore.epic: Was laid out by everyone for the stargazing night, and the field looked like a patchwork.
lore.legendary: Lay under a shooting star shower so bright that its sleeper made a hundred wishes.

names.legendary: The Tallest Sunflower in the Village

lore.common: Droops its heavy head so low that it looks sad.
lore.uncommon: Turns to face the sun all day, so every photo is from behind.
lore.rare: Grows a centimetre taller every time someone measures it.
lore.epic: Bloomed in a field so huge that the whole hill turned yellow.
lore.legendary: Grew taller than the village church roof, and the birds held a feast on its seeds.

names.legendary: The Bin That Fed the Garden

lore.common: Creaks its lid open and lets out a smell that clears the garden.
lore.uncommon: Is home to a thousand wriggling worms.
lore.rare: Turns banana skins into soil so fast that the gardener suspects magic.
lore.epic: Turned a whole summer of garden clippings into soil, and the vegetables grew huge.
lore.legendary: Fed a whole allotment with its soil for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Bin That Swallowed the Takeaway

lore.common: Flips its lid up so fast that it bangs the cupboard above.
lore.uncommon: Misses its pedal every time you step on it in a hurry.
lore.rare: Snaps its lid down on your fingers as you drop something in.
lore.epic: Overflowed after the birthday party until the lid stood straight up like a hat.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a whole family's takeaway boxes in one night and still closed its lid.

names.legendary: The Bin That Kept the Washroom Tidy

lore.common: Sits quietly in the corner of every washroom stall.
lore.uncommon: Has a lid that closes softly so nobody notices it.
lore.rare: Keeps the washroom tidy without anyone ever thanking it.
lore.epic: Was emptied in every washroom of the stadium at half-time, and the cleaners had a busy break.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same washroom tidy for twenty years without a single complaint.

names.legendary: The Bin That Kept Everyone Safe

lore.common: Has a bright yellow lid so that nobody mistakes it for anything else.
lore.uncommon: Clicks shut and locks so it can never be opened again.
lore.rare: Keeps the clinic safe by swallowing every used needle.
lore.epic: Was filled at the flu clinic in one morning, and a fresh one had to be fetched.
lore.legendary: Has kept a whole hospital ward safe for years without a single accident.

names.legendary: The Basket That Caught Every Shot

lore.common: Is missed by every paper ball thrown at it.
lore.uncommon: Collects every crumpled idea from the day.
lore.rare: Overflows by lunchtime and spills paper onto the carpet.
lore.epic: Was the target of an office paper basketball match that lasted all afternoon.
lore.legendary: Caught a paper ball thrown from across the whole office, and everyone cheered.

names.legendary: The Bin That Rolled Down the Hill

lore.common: Wobbles on the kerb every bin day and tips over in the wind.
lore.uncommon: Flaps its lid in the breeze like it's trying to talk.
lore.rare: Gets toppled by the fox every single night.
lore.epic: Was blown over in a gale and carried down the street like a runaway sledge, lid flapping.
lore.legendary: Rolled all the way to the bottom of the town and was found in the duck pond.

names.legendary: The Tulip That Bloomed Twice

lore.common: Closes its petals at night as if it's going to sleep.
lore.uncommon: Droops its stem in the vase after one day.
lore.rare: Changes colour each spring, so the gardener has to guess what it will be this time.
lore.epic: Bloomed in a field so big that the whole countryside looked striped.
lore.legendary: Bloomed twice in one spring, and the gardeners all came to see how.

names.legendary: The Sprinkler That Saved the Lawn

lore.common: Sprays the path more than the lawn.
lore.uncommon: Ticks round in a circle so slowly that you can run through the gap.
lore.rare: Makes every child in the street run through it shrieking.
lore.epic: Was left on all night by mistake, and the whole garden turned into a swamp full of happy frogs.
lore.legendary: Saved the whole lawn through the hottest summer ever recorded.

names.legendary: The Head That Popped Up on Time

lore.common: Pops up out of the lawn when you're sitting on it.
lore.uncommon: Gets run over by the lawnmower every summer.
lore.rare: Twists its spray in a direction nobody expected.
lore.epic: Popped up across the whole park during the picnic, and everyone grabbed their sandwiches.
lore.legendary: Has popped up at six every morning for twenty years to water the town park.

names.legendary: The Cap That Became a Teacup

lore.common: Is used as a whistle by blowing across it, which makes a shriek.
lore.uncommon: Is the perfect size for a fairy's hat, according to every child.
lore.rare: Gets hoarded by squirrels who forget where they hid it.
lore.epic: Was collected by the whole class on a nature walk, and the classroom filled with tiny hats.
lore.legendary: Was used as a teacup at a fairy party that lasted all summer in the garden.

names.legendary: The Plant That Lived on Air

lore.common: Grows without any soil, which confuses everyone.
lore.uncommon: Needs dunking in water once a week like a little bath.
lore.rare: Sits on a seashell or a rock and looks quite pleased.
lore.epic: Was hung on strings all round the café, and the whole place looked like a floating garden.
lore.legendary: Lived on nothing but air and a weekly bath for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Plant That Soothed Every Burn

lore.common: Oozes gooey gel from every leaf you snap.
lore.uncommon: Is rubbed on sunburn by every grandma.
lore.rare: Grows little baby plants all round its base that need new pots.
lore.epic: Soothed every sunburnt shoulder after the beach holiday.
lore.legendary: Has grown so many babies that every house on the street has one.

names.legendary: The Bamboo That Grew a Metre a Day

lore.common: Grows so fast that it pokes up through the patio.
lore.uncommon: Has a hollow stem that whistles in the wind.
lore.rare: Grows taller overnight than the gardener can believe.
lore.epic: Took over the whole garden in one summer, and the neighbours found it in their shed.
lore.legendary: Grew a metre in one day, and the gardener measured it every hour.

names.legendary: The Begonia That Bloomed All Year

lore.common: Drops a leaf every time it's moved.
lore.uncommon: Has waxy flowers that look almost like plastic.
lore.rare: Grows happily in the darkest corner where nothing else will.
lore.epic: Bloomed in every windowbox on the street at once, and the whole road glowed pink.
lore.legendary: Bloomed every single day of the year without a break, and the neighbours were very jealous.

names.legendary: The Tiny Tree of Three Hundred Years

lore.common: Is so small that visitors think it's a toy.
lore.uncommon: Gets snipped so carefully that it takes an hour for one branch.
lore.rare: Looks exactly like a giant old tree, just shrunk.
lore.epic: Was shown at the bonsai show with a hundred others, and the hall looked like a tiny forest.
lore.legendary: Has been looked after by the same family for three hundred years and is still smaller than a cat.

names.legendary: The Cane That Hooked the Moon

lore.common: Gets stuck to the inside of your pocket.
lore.uncommon: Has red and white stripes that swirl round and round.
lore.rare: Is shaped like a hook, so it gets hung on everything.
lore.epic: Was handed out to every child at the winter fair, and the whole hall smelled of mint.
lore.legendary: Was hung so high on the tallest tree in the square that children said it hooked the moon.

names.legendary: The Cane That Walked a Thousand Miles

lore.common: Taps on the pavement so loudly that pigeons fly off.
lore.uncommon: Has a curved handle that hooks onto every table edge.
lore.rare: Leans on the wall and slides down with a clatter.
lore.epic: Kept pace with a whole walking group on a long country walk.
lore.legendary: Walked a thousand miles with the same grandad and is now worn smooth at the handle.

names.legendary: The Gazebo That Stayed Put

lore.common: Takes off like a kite in the first gust of wind.
lore.uncommon: Pinches fingers in its folding legs every time it's put up.
lore.rare: Collects a pool of rain on its roof that drops on whoever touches it.
lore.epic: Sheltered every stall at the rainy market, and nobody's cakes got wet.
lore.legendary: Stayed put through a gale that blew every other gazebo across the field.

names.legendary: The Carnation That Lasted a Month

lore.common: Has frilly petals that look like they've been cut with scissors.
lore.uncommon: Is pinned on every jacket at every wedding.
lore.rare: Lasts so long in a vase that people forget it's real.
lore.epic: Was pinned on every guest at the wedding, and the whole room smelled of cloves.
lore.legendary: Lasted a whole month in its vase, long after the other flowers had gone.

names.legendary: The Blossom That Fell Like Snow

lore.common: Drops petals on every car parked underneath.
lore.uncommon: Blooms for only a few days, so everyone rushes to see it.
lore.rare: Turns the whole tree into a pink cloud.
lore.epic: Bloomed along the whole avenue at once, and the city had a festival.
lore.legendary: Dropped its petals so thickly that the whole street looked like it had snowed pink.

names.legendary: The Chrysanthemum That Won the Show

lore.common: Only blooms when everything else in the garden has finished.
lore.uncommon: Has so many petals that it looks like a pompom.
lore.rare: Grows a flower so big that it needs a little stake to hold it up.
lore.epic: Bloomed with a thousand others at the autumn show, and the hall looked like a firework display.
lore.legendary: Grew a flower so perfect that the flower show judges took a photo for the newspaper.

names.legendary: The Lucky Four-Leaf Clover

lore.common: Has only three leaves every time someone looks for a fourth.
lore.uncommon: Covers the lawn so thickly that the bees come buzzing.
lore.rare: Grows back faster than the gardener can pull it out.
lore.epic: Was searched by every child on the school field, and one finally found a four-leaf one.
lore.legendary: Grew a four-leaf clover that brought a whole family good luck for a year.

names.legendary: The Stumps That Were Bowled Out

lore.common: Sends its bails flying across the pitch whenever the ball touches them.
lore.uncommon: Leans slightly backwards so they look tired.
lore.rare: Gets hit by the ball so often that they rattle at every throw.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in every innings of the village match, and the batters were very cross.
lore.legendary: Stood unbeaten through a whole day's play, and the bowlers gave up and had tea.

names.legendary: The Crutch That Helped Every Step

lore.common: Rubs its padded top under your arm until it's sore.
lore.uncommon: Makes going up stairs a slow, careful hop.
lore.rare: Keeps its user steady even on icy paths.
lore.epic: Helped every patient on the ward walk the hallway on recovery day.
lore.legendary: Helped a broken-legged runner back to fitness, and she ran the marathon the next year.

names.legendary: The Daffodil That Brought the Spring

lore.common: Nods its trumpet head in the wind like it's agreeing with everything.
lore.uncommon: Is always the first flower to come up in spring.
lore.rare: Blooms so brightly that everyone takes a photo.
lore.epic: Bloomed across a whole hillside at once, and the whole valley turned yellow.
lore.legendary: Bloomed a week early one year, and spring followed it straight away.

names.legendary: The Dandelion That Seeded the Town

lore.common: Gets blown by every child to tell the time, which is always wrong.
lore.uncommon: Pops up in every lawn, no matter how often it's pulled.
lore.rare: Floats its seeds on the wind so far that they land in the next town.
lore.epic: Was blown by every child on the field at once, and the sky was full of floating seeds.
lore.legendary: Seeded so many lawns that the whole town turned yellow in one spring.

names.legendary: The Fence That Kept the Peace

lore.common: Keeps every football that goes over it.
lore.uncommon: Leans a little further each winter.
lore.rare: Has a little hedgehog-sized hole at the bottom that the hedgehogs use as a door.
lore.epic: Fell over in a storm, and two neighbours met for the first time in twenty years.
lore.legendary: Has stood between two gardens for fifty years and kept every dog on the right side.

names.legendary: The Fern Older Than the Dinosaurs

lore.common: Uncurls so slowly that you can watch it for a whole morning.
lore.uncommon: Grows only in the shadiest, dampest corners of the garden.
lore.rare: Looks so prehistoric that every child expects a dinosaur to come round the corner.
lore.epic: Spread across the whole woodland floor, and the walkers felt like they were in a jungle.
lore.legendary: Belongs to a family of plants older than the dinosaurs, and still uncurls every spring.

names.legendary: The Fig That Grew Through the Ceiling

lore.common: Sheds a pile of leaves every time it's moved.
lore.uncommon: Hates being moved and sulks for weeks.
lore.rare: Grows towards the window so it slowly leans across the office.
lore.epic: Grew so big in the office that the desks had to be moved round it.
lore.legendary: Grew all the way through the ceiling into the office above.

names.legendary: The Reel That Hooked the Big One

lore.common: Snags its hook on the angler's own hat on the very first cast.
lore.uncommon: Clicks so loudly that every fish in the lake knows it's there.
lore.rare: Casts so far that the float lands on the other side of the lake.
lore.epic: Was cast by every angler at the fishing match, and the lake was covered in floats.
lore.legendary: Hooked the biggest carp the lake had ever seen, and the photo hangs in the tackle shop.

names.legendary: The Rod That Caught a Wellington

lore.common: Casts its line straight into the tree behind its owner.
lore.uncommon: Catches old boots far more often than fish.
lore.rare: Waits so patiently on the riverbank that its owner falls asleep.
lore.epic: Was cast by every angler at the river competition, and the river looked like a harp.
lore.legendary: Caught a fish so big that it pulled its owner halfway across the river before letting go.

names.legendary: The Bouquet That Was Caught by a Dog

lore.common: Sheds petals all the way from the shop to the front door.
lore.uncommon: Is too big for every vase in the house.
lore.rare: Drops one petal every hour, so its owner always knows exactly how old it is.
lore.epic: Was tossed at the wedding and flew over every guest's head into the cake.
lore.legendary: Was tossed at a wedding and caught by the family dog, who wouldn't let go.

names.legendary: The Goal That Never Let a Ball Through

lore.common: Snags every ball in the hole in its net.
lore.uncommon: Rings like a bell every time the ball hits the post.
lore.rare: Swallows the ball so neatly that the goalkeeper doesn't even move.
lore.epic: Was the target of a penalty shootout that went on until it was too dark to see.
lore.legendary: Stopped every shot in a whole match, and the goalkeeper got all the credit.

names.legendary: The Garland That Spanned the Street

lore.common: Wilts a little more every hour it hangs.
lore.uncommon: Hangs over every doorway on party days.
lore.rare: Is made of so many flowers that it smells like a whole garden.
lore.epic: Was strung along every lamp post on festival day, and the whole street smelled of flowers.
lore.legendary: Was made so long that it stretched from one end of the village to the other.

names.legendary: The Gate the Cows Never Opened

lore.common: Creaks so loudly that the whole street knows someone's coming.
lore.uncommon: Jams its latch so you have to climb over it.
lore.rare: Gets swung on by every child, which it doesn't enjoy.
lore.epic: Was left open by a walker, and every cow on the farm went for a stroll.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same field's cows in for a hundred years without being opened by them once.

names.legendary: The Gazebo That Hosted Every Party

lore.common: Sways in the breeze so the bunting flutters all day.
lore.uncommon: Holds bunting round its edge like a crown.
lore.rare: Shades a whole party table on the sunniest day.
lore.epic: Sheltered every guest at the garden party when the rain suddenly poured.
lore.legendary: Has hosted every birthday party in the same garden for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Geranium That Bloomed on Every Sill

lore.common: Smells of lemon when you brush its leaves.
lore.uncommon: Sits in every windowbox on the street.
lore.rare: Bursts into bright red flowers that light up the whole window.
lore.epic: Bloomed in every windowbox in the village at once, and the streets turned red.
lore.legendary: Grew from one cutting into geraniums on every windowsill in the town.

names.legendary: The Lawn That Became a Meadow

lore.common: Leaves green stains on the knees of every pair of trousers.
lore.uncommon: Tickles bare feet on summer mornings.
lore.rare: Grows back taller every time it's mown.
lore.epic: Grew so long one summer that the children played hide and seek in it.
lore.legendary: Was left unmown for one summer and grew into a meadow full of butterflies.

names.legendary: The Hibiscus That Bloomed Every Morning

lore.common: Opens a new flower in the morning and drops it by evening.
lore.uncommon: Has a huge trumpet flower with a long stalk sticking out.
lore.rare: Turns any garden into a tropical island.
lore.epic: Bloomed so brightly at the garden party that guests put the flowers behind their ears.
lore.legendary: Bloomed a new flower every single morning for a whole summer.

names.legendary: The Pole That Climbed the Peak

lore.common: Clacks on every rock, so the hikers sound like a herd of goats.
lore.uncommon: Probes every puddle to see how deep it is.
lore.rare: Keeps its hiker steady on the steepest path.
lore.epic: Was used by the whole hiking group to cross a stream, and nobody fell in.
lore.legendary: Climbed the highest peak in the country with the same hiker every summer for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Hurdle Nobody Knocked Over

lore.common: Gets knocked over by every runner who clips it.
lore.uncommon: Bashes the knees of every runner who doesn't jump high enough.
lore.rare: Seems to grow taller every time someone runs at it.
lore.epic: Was knocked over in every lane at sports day, and the track looked like a game of skittles.
lore.legendary: Was cleared by a whole school race without a single runner touching it.

names.legendary: The Hydrangea That Changed Colour

lore.common: Turns pink in one garden and blue in the next, depending on the soil.
lore.uncommon: Has flower heads so big that they look like pompoms.
lore.rare: Changes colour if a rusty nail is buried beside it.
lore.epic: Bloomed in every seaside garden at once, and the coast turned blue.
lore.legendary: Changed from pink to blue in one summer, and the gardener has never worked out why.

names.legendary: The Iris That Lined the Lake

lore.common: Has petals in so many colours that it's named after a rainbow.
lore.uncommon: Has long leaves shaped like swords.
lore.rare: Grows happily with its feet in the boggiest mud.
lore.epic: Bloomed all round the edge of the pond, and the frogs had a purple fence.
lore.legendary: Lined the edge of the whole lake with purple, and the swans swam in a ring.

names.legendary: The Ivy That Covered the Castle

lore.common: Climbs up the wall and into the gutters.
lore.uncommon: Hugs the house so tightly that the windows disappear.
lore.rare: Grows back thicker every time it's cut down.
lore.epic: Grew over the whole house in one summer, and the postman couldn't find the letterbox.
lore.legendary: Covered a whole castle wall from the moat to the battlements.

names.legendary: The Jade That Outlived Everyone

lore.common: Has leaves so plump that they look like little green coins.
lore.uncommon: Is given as a lucky present at every housewarming.
lore.rare: Grows so slowly that its owner thinks it's plastic.
lore.epic: Grew so many babies from fallen leaves that the windowsill became a tiny forest.
lore.legendary: Was passed down through four generations of the same family, and still sits on the same windowsill.

names.legendary: The Jasmine That Scented the Street

lore.common: Smells strongest at night, just as everyone has gone to bed.
lore.uncommon: Twines round the trellis so tightly that nobody can untangle it.
lore.rare: Has little star-shaped flowers that glow white in the moonlight.
lore.epic: Scented the whole street on a summer night, and everyone opened their windows.
lore.legendary: Grew over the same garden archway for fifty years, and every bride in the family walked under it.

names.legendary: The Lavender That Made Everyone Sleepy

lore.common: Is covered in bees from morning till night.
lore.uncommon: Is tucked into pillows to help people sleep.
lore.rare: Smells so calm that everyone who walks past yawns.
lore.epic: Bloomed across a whole field, and the hills turned purple.
lore.legendary: Made a whole sleepover fall asleep at once, just by being in a little bag under the pillow.

names.legendary: The Last Leaf on the Tree

lore.common: Sticks to the bottom of your shoe and gets walked all the way into the house.
lore.uncommon: Crunches under every boot in autumn.
lore.rare: Sails on the wind so far that it lands in another town.
lore.epic: Blew off every tree in the park in one windy night, and the paths disappeared.
lore.legendary: Was the last leaf to fall from the old oak, and held on until the first snow.

names.legendary: The Lichen Older Than the Castle

lore.common: Paints rocks and walls in yellow and grey splodges.
lore.uncommon: Creeps across a boulder so slowly that it takes a hundred years to cover it.
lore.rare: Only grows where the air is clean, so it tells everyone the air is fresh.
lore.epic: Covered every stone on the old wall in a patchwork of colours.
lore.legendary: Has been growing on the same castle wall since before the castle was finished.

names.legendary: The Lily That Filled the Hall

lore.common: Stains everything orange with its pollen.
lore.uncommon: Has a bloom so big that it fills the whole vase.
lore.rare: Fills a room with a scent so strong that it's smelled from the hallway.
lore.epic: Bloomed in every vase at the flower show, and the hall smelled sweet for a week.
lore.legendary: Filled a whole hall with scent from a single stem.

names.legendary: The Lotus That Rose From the Mud

lore.common: Grows up out of the muddiest pond.
lore.uncommon: Has leaves so waterproof that raindrops roll off like marbles.
lore.rare: Opens its flower in the morning and closes it at night.
lore.epic: Bloomed across a whole pond, and the frogs had a pink carpet.
lore.legendary: Rose from the muddiest pond in the park and bloomed the most beautiful flower anyone had seen.

names.legendary: The Magnolia That Bloomed Leafless

lore.common: Drops its petals all over the lawn like a carpet.
lore.uncommon: Blooms so early that the frost sometimes catches it.
lore.rare: Has big waxy flowers that look like porcelain cups.
lore.epic: Bloomed across the whole park on the same day, and everyone stopped to take photos.
lore.legendary: Bloomed every spring for a hundred years before a single leaf appeared.

names.legendary: The Maple That Turned the Hill Red

lore.common: Drops spinning seeds that helicopter down onto everyone's head.
lore.uncommon: Turns bright red in autumn before every other tree.
lore.rare: Comes from a tree whose sap makes sweet syrup.
lore.epic: Turned the whole hillside red in one autumn week, and visitors came from miles away.
lore.legendary: Turned so red one autumn that the fire brigade came to check.

names.legendary: The Marigold That Guarded the Garden

lore.common: Is so bright orange that it glows in the flowerbed.
lore.uncommon: Shoos away bugs from the vegetables just by being there.
lore.rare: Is planted next to tomatoes as a little bodyguard.
lore.epic: Guarded the whole vegetable patch for a summer, and not a single pest got near.
lore.legendary: Kept a whole allotment pest-free for twenty years, planted in a ring round the edge.

names.legendary: The Detector That Found the Ring

lore.common: Beeps excitedly and finds a bottle cap every time.
lore.uncommon: Beeps so often on the beach that its owner digs a hundred holes.
lore.rare: Sweeps the sand so carefully that nothing metal escapes it.
lore.epic: Found so many coins on the beach that its owner bought everyone an ice cream.
lore.legendary: Found a lost wedding ring on the beach after twenty years, and the couple got married again.

names.legendary: The Tree That Never Grew Money

lore.common: Has a braided trunk that looks like it's been plaited.
lore.uncommon: Is given as a lucky present to every new shop.
lore.rare: Has never grown a single coin, despite its name.
lore.epic: Was put in every shop on the high street for luck, and the street was full of greenery.
lore.legendary: Has sat in the same bank window for fifty years and never grown a penny.

names.legendary: The Monstera That Took Over the Flat

lore.common: Has holes in its leaves that look like they've been nibbled.
lore.uncommon: Takes up half the living room with its giant leaves.
lore.rare: Sends out aerial roots that grab onto the curtains.
lore.epic: Grew so big in one summer that the family moved the sofa to make room.
lore.legendary: Took over a whole flat until the owners moved into the bedroom and gave it the lounge.

names.legendary: The Moss That Covered the Stones

lore.common: Squishes underfoot like a damp sponge.
lore.uncommon: Spreads across every shady path until it's slippery.
lore.rare: Turns hard stones into soft green cushions.
lore.epic: Covered the whole garden path in one wet winter, and everyone slipped on it.
lore.legendary: Covered every stone in an old wood so softly that walkers took off their shoes.

names.legendary: The Oar That Rowed Across the Bay

lore.common: Splashes the person in the front of the boat with every stroke.
lore.uncommon: Makes the boat go round in circles when only one is used.
lore.rare: Rattles in its rowlock so loudly that the ducks swim away.
lore.epic: Raced across the boating lake with every rowing boat at once, and the lake turned to foam.
lore.legendary: Rowed a little boat across the whole bay to the island and back before tea.

names.legendary: The Orchid That Bloomed for a Year

lore.common: Drops all its flowers the moment it's moved to a new windowsill.
lore.uncommon: Has silvery roots that climb out of the pot.
lore.rare: Blooms again just when everyone has given up on it.
lore.epic: Bloomed so beautifully at the orchid show that the judges took photos for an hour.
lore.legendary: Kept the same spray of flowers for a whole year, and the family stopped buying cut flowers.

names.legendary: The Paddle That Ran the Rapids

lore.common: Drips water down its handle onto its paddler's lap.
lore.uncommon: Switches from side to side so fast that it splashes everyone.
lore.rare: Steers through rapids that make other kayakers turn back.
lore.epic: Raced down the river with every kayak in the club, and the bank was soaked.
lore.legendary: Steered a kayak through the wildest rapids in the country without capsizing once.

names.legendary: The Pansy That Bloomed Through the Snow

lore.common: Has a little face on every flower that seems to be watching you.
lore.uncommon: Survives the frost when every other flower gives up.
lore.rare: Smiles out of the windowbox even on the greyest days.
lore.epic: Bloomed in every windowbox on the street in the middle of winter, and the street felt like spring.
lore.legendary: Bloomed right through a snowstorm, its little face poking out of the snow.

names.legendary: The Hat Worn at Every Birthday

lore.common: Snaps its elastic under your chin at the worst moment.
lore.uncommon: Is so pointy that it pokes the person next to you.
lore.rare: Gets squashed flat by the end of every party.
lore.epic: Was worn by every guest at the birthday party, and the room looked like a forest of cones.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at every birthday party in the family for twenty years and is still pointy.

names.legendary: The Lily That Came Back to Life

lore.common: Droops dramatically the moment it needs water, as if it's fainting.
lore.uncommon: Has white flowers that look like little sails.
lore.rare: Grows happily in the darkest office corner.
lore.epic: Perked up in every office at once after the weekend watering.
lore.legendary: Came back to life after a whole summer without water, and its owner cried with relief.

names.legendary: The Peony That Lived for a Hundred Years

lore.common: Is covered in ants every spring, which nobody understands.
lore.uncommon: Has a bloom so heavy that it falls over in the rain.
lore.rare: Opens from a tight little ball to a flower the size of a dinner plate overnight.
lore.epic: Burst into bloom across the whole garden in one June week.
lore.legendary: Has bloomed in the same garden for a hundred years without being moved.

names.legendary: The Basket That Overflowed With Petunias

lore.common: Has sticky petals that cling to your fingers.
lore.uncommon: Spills out of every hanging basket in the street.
lore.rare: Grows so thickly that the basket disappears.
lore.epic: Overflowed every hanging basket on the high street, and the shops looked like gardens.
lore.legendary: Grew so big in one basket that it touched the pavement.

names.legendary: The Cone That Told the Weather

lore.common: Opens when it's dry and closes when it's about to rain.
lore.uncommon: Gets chewed by squirrels down to a little core.
lore.rare: Has prickly tips that catch on your woolly gloves.
lore.epic: Was collected by the whole class on a woodland walk, and the classroom smelled of pine.
lore.legendary: Told the weather correctly every day for a whole year, better than the forecast.

names.legendary: The Poppy That Painted the Field

lore.common: Has petals so crinkly that they look like tissue paper.
lore.uncommon: Pops up in fields where nobody planted it.
lore.rare: Shakes its seed pod like a pepper pot in the wind.
lore.epic: Bloomed across a whole field at once, and the hill turned bright red.
lore.legendary: Spread from one seed pod into a field that could be seen from the motorway.

names.legendary: The Vine That Circled the Room

lore.common: Trails down from the shelf and tangles round the lamp.
lore.uncommon: Climbs up any shelf, curtain or bookcase it can reach.
lore.rare: Survives forgetful owners, dark rooms and months without water.
lore.epic: Trailed round every shelf in the office until the books were wrapped in leaves.
lore.legendary: Grew so long that it went round the whole classroom twice.

names.legendary: The Reed That Became a Flute

lore.common: Rustles so loudly by the pond that the fishermen think someone is sneaking up behind them.
lore.uncommon: Grows in a thick fence all round the edge of the pond.
lore.rare: Hides every bird's nest so well that nobody finds them.
lore.epic: Whispered in the wind across the whole marsh, and the walkers stopped to listen.
lore.legendary: Was cut and turned into a flute that played at the village festival.

names.legendary: The Plant That Reached the Ceiling

lore.common: Has leaves so shiny that they look polished.
lore.uncommon: Needs its leaves wiped every week, or they get dusty.
lore.rare: Pushes out a new leaf wrapped in a red sheath, like a present being unwrapped.
lore.epic: Grew so tall in the living room that its leaves brushed the ceiling.
lore.legendary: Grew from a tiny cutting to the ceiling of a whole hallway in ten years.

names.legendary: The Pod That Sowed a Meadow

lore.common: Pops open when touched and sprays seeds at your face.
lore.uncommon: Hitches a ride on the dog's fur and gets planted three streets away.
lore.rare: Spreads its seeds so far that they land three gardens away.
lore.epic: Burst open on every plant in the garden at once, and the air was full of flying seeds.
lore.legendary: Sowed a whole meadow from one pod that burst on a windy day.

names.legendary: The Pole That Pushed to the Finish

lore.common: Loses its little basket in the deep snow.
lore.uncommon: Pushes its skier along the flat bits when the slope runs out.
lore.rare: Gets clamped in the ski lift and has to be wiggled free.
lore.epic: Pushed every skier in the ski school across the flat part of the slope.
lore.legendary: Pushed its skier over the finish line by a hand's width to win the race.

names.legendary: The Plant That Couldn't Be Killed

lore.common: Stands so upright that it looks like it's on guard duty.
lore.uncommon: Survives being forgotten for months.
lore.rare: Freshens the air in the bedroom, according to every plant shop.
lore.epic: Was given to every student moving into halls, and every one survived the term.
lore.legendary: Has survived three house moves, two holidays and one very forgetful owner.

names.legendary: The Plant With a Thousand Babies

lore.common: Sends out baby plants on long stems that dangle everywhere.
lore.uncommon: Hangs from the basket with its babies swinging below.
lore.rare: Grows stripy leaves that look like they've been painted.
lore.epic: Had so many babies that every child at school took one home.
lore.legendary: Has grandchildren in every house on the street.

names.legendary: The Net That Called Every Let

lore.common: Catches the ball on its top and lets it drop over, which annoys everyone.
lore.uncommon: Sags in the middle so the ball always clips it.
lore.rare: Stops every serve that isn't perfect.
lore.epic: Hosted a rally so long that the crowd fell asleep and woke up for the point.
lore.legendary: Has stood at the same club for thirty years and caught a million serves.

names.legendary: The Tent That Stayed Dry

lore.common: Is always missing exactly one peg.
lore.uncommon: Has a zip that sticks just when you need the toilet in the night.
lore.rare: Drips rain on whoever sleeps nearest the wall.
lore.epic: Was pitched in a field with a thousand others, and nobody could find their own.
lore.legendary: Stayed perfectly dry through a whole week of rain at the festival.

names.legendary: The Thistle That Guarded the Field

lore.common: Pricks your legs when you walk through the meadow in shorts.
lore.uncommon: Puffs out fluffy seeds that float away like little parachutes.
lore.rare: Catches on socks and comes home with you.
lore.epic: Bloomed across the whole field, and the bees had their best day of the year.
lore.legendary: Guarded a whole field so well that the picnickers sat somewhere else.

names.legendary: The Flytrap That Ate a Wasp

lore.common: Snaps shut on anything that touches it, including your finger.
lore.uncommon: Waits so still for a fly that it looks fake.
lore.rare: Snaps so fast that the fly doesn't know what happened.
lore.epic: Snapped up every fly in the kitchen in one summer, and the family loved it.
lore.legendary: Caught a wasp that had been bothering a whole picnic, and the picnickers cheered.

names.legendary: The Vine That Climbed the House

lore.common: Wraps itself round the fence and won't let go.
lore.uncommon: Grabs everything with its little curly tendrils.
lore.rare: Hangs bunches of grapes so low that the birds steal them first.
lore.epic: Wound itself through the garden furniture so tightly that the family ate dinner on the lawn for a month.
lore.legendary: Climbed all the way up the house to the roof and grew grapes in the gutter.

names.legendary: The Violet That Hid in the Wood

lore.common: Hides under leaves so well that only bees can find it.
lore.uncommon: Has little purple flowers that face the ground.
lore.rare: Smells so sweet that people stop and look for it.
lore.epic: Carpeted the whole woodland floor in spring, and walkers tiptoed through.
lore.legendary: Hid in the same wood for a hundred years, blooming every spring for anyone who looked.

names.legendary: The Net That Saw the Longest Rally

lore.common: Sags in the sand so it's lower at one end.
lore.uncommon: Blocks every spike with a satisfying twang.
lore.rare: Stands so firmly in the sand that the wind can't move it.
lore.epic: Hosted a beach rally so long that the tide came in and went out again.
lore.legendary: Has stood on the same beach every summer for twenty years.

names.legendary: The Stick That Walked the Whole Coast

lore.common: Has a knobbly top that fits only one hand perfectly.
lore.uncommon: Pokes every puddle on the walk to check how deep it is.
lore.rare: Helps its walker up every hill without complaining.
lore.epic: Rambled across the whole national park with a walking group in one long weekend.
lore.legendary: Walked the entire coast of the country with the same owner over twenty years.

names.legendary: The Lily Pad That Held a Frog Choir

lore.common: Floats its pads so flat that the frogs think they're stepping stones.
lore.uncommon: Is the favourite seat of every frog in the pond.
lore.rare: Hides its flower under the water on cold days and pops it up again when the sun comes out.
lore.epic: Covered the whole village pond so thickly that the ducks walked across it.
lore.legendary: Grew pads so big that a whole choir of frogs sang on one.

names.legendary: The Meadow That Grew Itself

lore.common: Blooms on roadsides where nobody planted it.
lore.uncommon: Throws a party for every bee and butterfly nearby.
lore.rare: Mixes every colour in a meadow so it looks like a painting.
lore.epic: Bloomed along every roadside in the county, and the drivers slowed down to look.
lore.legendary: Turned a whole empty car park into a meadow that buzzed with bees.

names.legendary: The Wreath That Welcomed Everyone

lore.common: Falls off its nail every time the door slams.
lore.uncommon: Sheds pine needles all over the doormat.
lore.rare: Makes every visitor stop and say how lovely before they knock.
lore.epic: Hung on every front door on the street, and the whole road looked welcoming.
lore.legendary: Has hung on the same front door every winter for fifty years.
